coverage_review.rendered_review: Full 261 rendered lines read separately. Independently verified source hashes and numbered canonical pages against frozen git show; all rendered ranges cover full files without gaps or conflicting overlaps. name_collision_checks.result: Four refreshed aliases exist only on their intended baseline subjects. New gm_ExitCameraModeCSSScene has no baseline or canonical-source collision.

section_evidence.independent_result: ELF32 big-endian parsing confirms .data size 120 entirely occupied by gm_Mode_Camera_States and .sbss size 8 entirely occupied by gm_804D68C8. Sixteen .rela.data entries independently match the four callback pairs and four payload pairs in source. Both state-0 payload relocations reference gm_804D68C8. Frozen report unit has matching section sizes and addresses.
section_evidence.provenance_limit: Existing build object was inspected read-only, not regenerated.
